The present verse enjoins that when these things are

Our answer to the above is as follows:—As for mere

completed)? As forthe particular form of ‘disposal,’ this
helps the Rite only when what has become damaged
forms an integral part of the Nite itself. Nor again have

etc., are worn, for the fulfilment of which purpose, the
